items.title: Call to Order
notes: Chair Redman called the meeting to order at 4:45 p.m.

items.title: Land Acknowledgement
notes:
I would like to acknowledge that the land on which we gather today is the traditional territory of the Haudenosaunee (hoh-DEE-noh-SHoh-nee), Anishnawbe (Ah-nish-ih-nah'-bey) and Chonnonton (Chi-nawn-ton) peoples. 
In doing this, I want to reflect on what it means to be doing important community work like we are engaging in collectively today, and also my own individual relationship to this land.
As a settler, one of the most important aspects of my individual journey towards Truth and Reconciliation has been to listen, and I am continually grateful that the community continues to share their stories and concerns with me.
As, well, as the Chair of the Region, I know that I carry a large responsibility to ensure that it is not just myself on an individual level listening and acting, but that as a government we are listening and creating action with community.
I am offering this acknowledgement as one of many actions I am personally, and the Region largely, is taking in our journey toward reconciliation.
We acknowledge the enduring presence of the Indigenous people with whom we share this land today, their achievements and their contributions to our community.

Chair Redman provided a land acknowledgement.

motions.item_title: COR-TRY-25-009, PQ2024-17 Request For Prequalification EarlyON Lead Agency
motions.text: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo take the following action with respect to PQ2024-17 Request for Prequalification - EarlyON Lead Agency as set out in report COR-TRY-25-009 dated February 26, 2025. Approve the selection of YMCA of Three Rivers (Mid-Western Ontario) as the EarlyON Child and Family Centres lead agency in Waterloo Region for an eight (8) year term effective January 1, 2026; Approve annual funding to YMCA based on Provincial EarlyON allocations to the Region, with an estimated amount of $4,329,945 in 2026; and Authorize Children’s Services to execute such agreements and documentation in a form satisfactory to the Regional Solicitor as may be required to process the funding to the YMCA as the successful proponent recommended for award.
motions.text_html:
That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo take the following action with respect to PQ2024-17 Request for Prequalification - EarlyON Lead Agency as set out in report COR-TRY-25-009 dated February 26, 2025.

  1. Approve the selection of YMCA of Three Rivers (Mid-Western Ontario) as the EarlyON Child and Family Centres lead agency in Waterloo Region for an eight (8) year term effective January 1, 2026;
  2. Approve annual funding to YMCA based on Provincial EarlyON allocations to the Region, with an estimated amount of $4,329,945 in 2026; and
  3. Authorize Children’s Services to execute such agreements and documentation in a form satisfactory to the Regional Solicitor as may be required to process the funding to the YMCA as the successful proponent recommended for award.

motions.item_title: Sustainability, Infrastructure, and Development Summary - February 11, 2025
motions.text: 1. That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo take the following action with respect to the upcoming 2026 curbside waste collection changes as set out in report EES-WMS-25-001, dated February 11, 2025: Amend the 2025 Waste Management Division Operating Budget to include an expenditure of $1.25 million to prepare for the implementation of the new collection contract, to be offset from the estimated one-time 2025 revenues relating to the Blue Box Program transition to Extended Producer Responsibility with no tax levy impact; Include expenditures of $1.49 million in 2026 and $452,000 in 2027 to the Waste Management Division Operating Budget, funded from the Waste Management Reserve Fund with no tax levy impact; and Add 18 temporary (up to two-year) FTEs to support the successful implementation of the new waste collection contract.
motions.text_html:
1. That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo take the following action with respect to the upcoming 2026 curbside waste collection changes as set out in report EES-WMS-25-001, dated February 11, 2025:
Amend the 2025 Waste Management Division Operating Budget to include an expenditure of $1.25 million to prepare for the implementation of the new collection contract, to be offset from the estimated one-time 2025 revenues relating to the Blue Box Program transition to Extended Producer Responsibility with no tax levy impact;
Include expenditures of $1.49 million in 2026 and $452,000 in 2027 to the Waste Management Division Operating Budget, funded from the Waste Management Reserve Fund with no tax levy impact; and

motions.text: The Library Committee recommends as follows: That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo direct Staff to provide the exact and complete costs and revenue of library operations and facilities for all the Townships for the previous three fiscal years. And that the information will be provided at the next Library Committee meeting. That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo directs Staff to work with the external auditor to look into the former shared position and relationship between the Region of Waterloo Library and Smart Waterloo Region Innovation Lab. And that any costs be funded through the Library budget to a maximum of $10,000. And that Regional Council fund the remaining costs.
motions.text_html:
The Library Committee recommends as follows:

  1. That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo direct Staff to provide the exact and complete costs and revenue of library operations and facilities for all the Townships for the previous three fiscal years.

    And that the information will be provided at the next Library Committee meeting.

  2. That the Regional Municipality of Waterloo directs Staff to work with the external auditor to look into the former shared position and relationship between the Region of Waterloo Library and Smart Waterloo Region Innovation Lab.

    And that any costs be funded through the Library budget to a maximum of $10,000.

    And that Regional Council fund the remaining costs.
